title: Prompt chaining
sub: Break the task into fixed steps. The model fills each one in; your code decides the order.

steps.d: "Is the DR-520 vent length still 35 feet?"

steps.h: Your code asks the model to split the question into search queries
steps.d:
"DR-520 vent length maximum"
"DR-520 vent service bulletin"

steps.h: Your code retrieves for each query and merges the results
steps.d:
dr520-manual#4    Venting Requirements
service-bulletin#2  Revised Vent Specification

steps.h: Your code asks the model to draft from what came back
steps.d:
"No. The manual originally stated 35 feet [dr520-manual#4],
but a later service bulletin lowered the DR-520 limit to
25 feet [service-bulletin#2]."

steps.h: Your code checks the draft's citations against what was actually retrieved
steps.d:
claimed: dr520-manual#4, service-bulletin#2
retrieved: dr520-manual#4, service-bulletin#2
kept: both (nothing ungrounded)
